paper.title_en: Bumpy inflation from explosive particle production
paper.abstract_en: We present a first-principles derivation of an effective inflaton potential with a bumpy feature. We consider the coupling of a spectator field χto the inflaton ϕsuch that χis massive enough for almost all values of ϕ, but becomes massless when the inflaton crossed the value ϕ_⋆. This gives rise to a burst of χ-particle production at ϕ=ϕ_⋆. By taking the backreaction of the particle production, we obtain a bumpy feature in the effective potential.
